manualSourceReview.ownership: feed sets the active iterator before returning. A rejected competing feed or EOF leaves ownership intact. Normal exhausted next releases it; explicit early close and parsing errors additionally close and discard the parser state.
manualSourceReview.yieldOrder: Each next returns a completed frame before looking at the following header, so an invalid suffix does not suppress a preceding valid frame.
manualSourceReview.inputReferences: finish releases the top-level input memoryview and removes the iterator references to that view and parser. Temporary slices use memoryview context managers. The execution checks also keep protocol-error tracebacks alive and check their candidate-frame views for release.
manualSourceReview.workBound: For immutable byte chunks and sequential calls, each consumed header or payload byte is appended once; completed payload conversion copies that payload once. Bounded header unpacking and constant iterator operations give amortized O(B + K) for B bytes and K feed calls, using the standard bytearray growth model.
manualSourceReview.storageBound: Copied header storage is at most twelve bytes and the unfinished payload is at most the cap. The parser has one input view; it does not accumulate yielded outputs. This supports O(cap) internal copied storage under the stated exclusions, not a strict one-cap peak-byte bound.

scope: Selective full-source execution of the completed DSA round-12 parser, not a whole-interview accuracy rate or proof of every input. The 759 functional cases are dependent finite checks, not independent interview draws. No real network concurrency, simultaneous calls or exact peak-memory benchmark was performed. Full source-contract and other-answer judgments remain separately reviewable.
